coordinateSystem: Original body-fixed radar-model Cartesian axes; positive Z is the selected spin pole; east-positive longitude; arbitrary display phase
source: Brozović et al. (2010), Icarus 208, 207–220; Arecibo, Goldstone and NASA/JPL radar astronomy: ecliptic J2000 lambda 337 deg, beta 19 deg, period 67.5 h; equatorial conversion uses J2000 obliquity 23.439291111 deg. This is the archived prograde principal-axis model. The source research also permits a nearly mirrored retrograde solution; the pole and rotational sense are not unique. Near-pole-on observations constrain its unobserved southern shape less strongly. The period is 67.5 ± 6.0 h; a small non-principal-axis component was not excluded. No resolved optical surface map is supplied.
